versions.text:
(a) The takeoff speeds described in Sec. 25.55, the accelerate-stop distance described in Sec. 25.57, and the takeoff path described in Sec. 25.59, must be determined--
  (1) At each weight and altitude selected by the applicant;
  (2) With a constant takeoff flap position for the weight and altitude; and
  (3) With the operating engines within approved operating limitations.
(b) No takeoff made to determine the data required by this section may require exceptional piloting skill or alertness.
(c) The takeoff data must be based on--
  (1) A smooth, dry, hard-surfaced runway, in the case of landplanes and amphibians;
  (2) Smooth water, in the case of seaplanes and amphibians; and
  (3) Smooth, dry snow, in the case of skiplanes.
(d) Temperature accountability corrections must be made in accordance with Sec. 25.61.
